skill.name: yescan-scan-universal
skill.description: Enhances one image through the Quark Scan King API, using a URL, local file path, or base64 input. It supports document cleanup, quality improvement, crop correction, line art extraction, and watermark or handwriting removal.
skill.summary: Enhance and clean one image through the Quark Scan King API, with local temp-file output.
skill.author: yescan-ai

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection, malware loader, or hidden credential exfiltration was found in the inspected files. Confirmed risks are intentional third-party image upload, SCAN_WEBSERVICE_KEY handling, plaintext ~/.yescan_env fallback, and temp-file output persistence. A separate semantic risk exists because the skill promotes watermark and handwriting removal, which can enable unauthorized document or ownership-mark alteration.

remediation.issue: Third-party upload of user images and API key
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before processing sensitive screenshots, IDs, contracts, or private documents, and show the Quark endpoint before upload.
Prefer environment variables or an OS secret store, enforce 0600 permissions when the file fallback is used, and document key rotation clearly.

remediation.issue: Processed images persist in the system temp directory
remediation.suggestion: Add optional automatic cleanup, configurable output directories, and clear user messaging for deleting sensitive results.

remediation.issue: Watermark and handwriting removal can be misused
remediation.suggestion: Add policy guidance requiring authorization for watermark removal and document alteration use cases, with refusal language for suspicious requests.

content.user_title: Enhance Scanned Images with Quark Scan King
content.value_statement: Blurry document photos and screenshots are hard to read or archive. This skill sends one image to Quark Scan King and saves a cleaned result locally.
actual_capabilities: Accepts one image as a URL, local file path, or base64 string.
Runs scene modes for exams, certificates, contracts, general documents, and crop correction.
Can remove shadows, screen patterns, background color, handwriting, and watermarks from images.
Can convert images to sketch style or extract line art.
Sends requests to scan-business.quark.cn using SCAN_WEBSERVICE_KEY.
Saves enhanced image results to a system temp imgs directory and returns the local path.
limitations: Requires Python 3.9+, the requests package, network access, and a Quark API key.
Sends the image and API key to a third-party service, so sensitive images need prior approval.
Processes one static image per run and limits local image files to 5 MB.
This skill surface does not extract text, create Office files, or generate new AI images.

use_cases.title: Clean Office Scans
use_cases.description: Improve contract, receipt, or certificate photos before archiving or sharing.

use_cases.title: Improve Study Materials
use_cases.description: Enhance exam papers, handwritten notes, and textbook photos for clearer reading.

use_cases.title: Prepare Visual References
use_cases.description: Extract line art or make sketch-style references from a single source image.

prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance this blurry document photo and show me the saved result path: [image path or URL].

prompt_templates.prompt: Crop and straighten this tilted document scan. Use the image-crop-rectify scene for this one file: [path].

output_examples.output: The skill returns a success message with a temp image path for the cleaned receipt.

output_examples.input: Remove shadows from a contract image URL.
output_examples.output: The skill returns the processed image location after the remote service finishes.

output_examples.input: Extract line art from a product sketch image.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a local image path containing the extracted line drawing.

best_practices: Confirm the user has rights to process the image, especially for watermark or handwriting removal.
Prefer environment variables for keys, restrict any key file permissions, and rotate keys when needed.
Delete temp output images when they are no longer needed, especially after processing sensitive documents.
anti_patterns: Uploading confidential IDs, contracts, or screenshots without explicit approval.
Using watermark or handwriting removal to bypass rights, marks, or document controls.
Passing directories, batches, videos, or unsupported file formats to a single-image workflow.

faq.question: Does this skill run locally only?
faq.answer: No. It sends the user-provided image to the Quark Scan King API for processing.

faq.question: What inputs are supported?
faq.answer: It supports one image per run, supplied as a URL, local file path, or base64 string.

faq.question: Where are processed images saved?
faq.answer: Processed images are saved under the system temp directory, usually in an imgs subdirectory.

faq.question: Can it process private documents?
faq.answer: Only with explicit approval. The image and API key are sent to a third-party service.

faq.question: Does it perform OCR or file conversion?
faq.answer: No. This skill focuses on visual enhancement and cleanup, not text extraction or Office conversion.

faq.question: What key is required?
faq.answer: It requires SCAN_WEBSERVICE_KEY from the Quark Scan King developer console.
